answer_2.quote: As our evaluation metric for model performance, we computed entire-sequence log probabilities for acceptable and unacceptable sentences in each pair using the minicons library... We also report Pearson's correlation between human and model evaluations... We also experimented with using Syntactic Log-Odds Ratio (SLOR) scores

answer_4.quote: To validate our benchmark, we collected acceptability judgments from 30 native Turkish speakers using a 7-point Likert scale (1: completely unacceptable, 7: completely acceptable)... Each participant rated 216 sentences spanning 16 linguistic phenomena
answer_4.guideline: 7-point Likert scale rating grammatical acceptability (1: completely unacceptable, 7: completely acceptable)
